### 590: all four-weight first-shift cases have sharp finite closure

Exact first shift gives [E,[E,D]]=0. For ordered four distinct spectral
weights alpha<beta<gamma<delta, the sole possible unordered pair-sum
collision is alpha+delta=beta+gamma. All other component brackets vanish,
and the two exceptional brackets are proportional. Jacobi makes their
common value K central. Thus the component algebra is abelian or has
five-dimensional two-step Heisenberg form.

The LND conclusion is proved using actual Euler-torus conjugates of E.
They span the components. In the noncommuting case, conjugating one LND
by another gives V+cK; its commuting difference with V proves K is an
LND. The finite central exponential formula makes every linear
combination of the four conjugates and K locally nilpotent. This is a
whole polynomial-flow proof, not an unsupported claim about arbitrary
spectral projections. K is independent of the four components even if
its weight equals one of theirs; otherwise centrality contradicts that
component's nonzero paired bracket. D is independent because it is not
an LND. Consequently dim Lie(D,E)<=6, with equality in the noncommuting
four-weight case.

The entire actual sharp frame is

    (u,a+u^2,b+au+u^4,c-bu/2+au^2/2+u^3), degrees(1,2,4,3).

Its full Euler is u partial_u+2a partial_a+(4b+au)partial_b+
(3c+bu)partial_c, of exact shift1. The four weights are(-2,-1,0,1).
The only nonzero component brackets are
[-2,1]=-a partial_c/2 and[-1,0]=3a partial_c/2. A direct six-element
basis and every closure bracket are supplied. The example has a visible
coordinate slice and polynomial kernel. It does not obstruct recognition.

### 582: finite homogeneous-slice recognition, with an actual shift-one failure

For actual B=C[X1,...,Xn]=A[u], E=partial_u and positive d_i=deg_E Xi,
let D be the weighted Euler field and o its source-coordinate origin.
Every homogeneous E-slice has weight in the finite nonempty set

    Lambda={d_i : E(X_i)(o) != 0}.

For each such weight, its whole homogeneous monomial space is finite.
Comparing coefficients in E(v)=1 is an exact finite linear criterion.
If successful, v has a nonzero linear term of its own weight; all other
nonlinear terms use smaller-weight variables. Solving for that one
source variable explicitly proves v is a coordinate. Since v-u is in
A, the quotient B/(v) identifies with A and proves polynomiality.
Taylor projection supplies the actual invariant coordinate completion.
No kernel presentation is assumed. This is an algebraic criterion, not
an implemented solver; effectivity needs exactly specified coefficients.

At exact shift one the full coefficient system is

    D|A=M+uN, Du=b1*u+b0,
    N(q)=lambda-b1, M(q)+b0=lambda*q.

The last two equations are necessary and sufficient for u+q to be an
eigen-slice. The image quotient A/N(A) is a vector-space quotient, not
implicitly a quotient ring. M need not be locally finite.

The revised control starts from E=(1+a^2)partial_x+a partial_z on
C[a,x,z,c]. Its genuine slice u=x-az and invariant b=ax-(1+a^2)z have
the whole inverse x=(1+a^2)u-ab, z=au-b. The actual positive frame
(x,a+x,z,c+x) has degree tuple(1,1,1,1). Its full Euler field has

    Da=a, Dc=c, Du=(1-a^2)u+ab,
    Db=(1+a^2)b+a(1-a^2)u, N=a(1-a^2)partial_b.

Thus delta=1. Every candidate homogeneous slice is linear in(a,x,z,c),
but alpha(1+a^2)+beta*a cannot equal1. More strongly, the first slice
adjustment equation would give lambda=1 at a=0 and lambda=0 at a=1.
No homogeneous slice or even constant slice coefficient is obtainable.
The kernel is nonetheless explicitly polynomial, and primitive division
of N gives partial_b with slice b. General first-shift recognition is
NOT disproved. The separate retained degree(4,5,6,7) control has shift12
and is not the evidence for the shift-one conclusion.

### 583: a complete fixed-slice monotone replica chain can stall

The actual frame

    (u,a+u^2,b+au+u^4,
     c-b^2*u/3+ab*u^2/3-a^2*u^3/3+u^6)

has pair(13,1), full Euler D=D_A+uE+uN, D_A of weights(2,4,6),
and primitive nonsliced N=a partial_b+b^2 partial_c. For every
F in S[u], S=ker_A N, the entire replica flow is polynomial. Reduction
modulo(a,b) proves no coordinate degree can drop. The cubic flow term
forces deg_u F<=2 for a nonincreasing sum. Remove F0 by filtered
equivariance, and write F=uF1+u^2F2. The entire u^2 Euler coefficient
has components

    T2(b)=-aQ,
    T2(c)=-b^2Q-4b^2F2-4abF1^2,
    Q=D_A(F2)+F1*[N,D_A](F1).

Shift<=1 forces Q=0 and bF2+aF1^2=0. Applying N then forces
F2=F1=0. Hence every nonincreasing move has F in S, independent of u.
Such moves preserve the recovered extension N and commute with every
subsequent replica. Induction excludes ANY finite nonincreasing escape
under this exact same-slice/recomputed-direction rule.
Other Lie directions explicitly escape, and the visible homogeneous
slice already recognizes this known polynomial example. Slice changes,
temporary increases and arbitrary coordinate moves are not excluded.

### 587: a sufficient finite first-shift spectral-closure criterion

For any actual first-shift frame, the whole induced positive-degree LND
argument gives ad_E^2 D=0. Write E=sum E_lambda for its finite actual
D-spectral decomposition. Grouping that double commutator gives

    sum_(lambda<mu, lambda+mu=s) (mu-lambda)[E_lambda,E_mu]=0.

If every unordered pair of distinct weights has a different sum, the
components commute. This condition is automatic for at most three
weights. They are LNDs: the torus conjugates of E are commuting LNDs,
and finite invertible evaluation of distinct Laurent monomials expresses
each component as a linear combination of those conjugates. The
multinomial argument proves local nilpotence of that combination.
Interpolation puts each component in Lie(D,E), so this Lie algebra is
exactly C*D semidirect the component span, of dimension r+1. Their
flows define an actual torus-normalized additive action. This argument
does not assume polynomial generators of A.

The entire first-shift control583 has five weights -2,-1,0,1,2 with
nonzero component brackets cancelling at repeated sums. Its components
need not preserve A or commute with E. Nevertheless all five are LNDs,
and its full Lie algebra is exactly nine-dimensional:

    span_C{D,E,a partial_b} +
    span_C{b^2,abu,a^2u^2,ab,a^2u,a^2} partial_c.

The proof gives both generation and bracket closure, not just sampled
rank stabilization. So this is not a counterexample to finite closure
at shift1. Revised582 has commuting components partial_x, a partial_z,
a^2 partial_x but no homogeneous E-slice. A coordinate slice for one
component is not a slice for their sum. General first-shift finite
closure and individual spectral local nilpotence remain unproved in
the repeated-pair-sum case; no kernel recognition follows automatically
from the established finite-dimensional action conclusion.

### 579: a finite parameter-degree bound and exact scalar criterion

Let B=C[X1,...,Xn]=A[u], E=partial_u, all actual degrees d_i positive,
and let N be the nonzero recovered LND extended to kill u. The bounds
in fact apply to any such nonzero extended LND, without assuming A is
polynomial. For F in (ker_A N)[u], exp(FN) is an actual automorphism.
Let I consist of coordinates changed by N. If k=deg_u(F)>d_i for an
active i, the entire polynomial exp(TN)Xi has a UNIQUE highest term
after T=F: the exponents j+kr are distinct because 0<=j<=d_i<k.
Its degree is k*deg_N(Xi)+deg_u(N^deg_N(Xi)Xi), strictly greater
than d_i. No cancellation among lower coefficients is discarded.

Thus coordinatewise nonincrease requires k<=min_{i in I}d_i, and
nonincrease of the degree sum requires k<=max_{i in I}d_i. The latter
does not silently forbid individual degree increases. Both statements
allow full invariant coefficients. The u-constant term of F can be
removed: its exponential commutes with E and preserves the exact
filtration and the Euler shift under conjugation.

For scalar coefficients, only finitely many parameters lambda_j in
F=sum_{j=1}^M lambda_j*u^j need be considered. Enumerating exact
nonnegative degree profiles e with sum(e)<=sum(d), and imposing
E^(e_i+1)Phi_F(Xi)=0 and E^e_i Phi_F(Xi)!=0, gives finite constructible
profile loci. Zero-degree coordinates are explicitly allowed; the
all-zero profile is impossible. On EACH profile the actual Euler
derivation is

    D_{e,F}=Phi_F (sum e_i Xi partial_Xi) Phi_F^-1,

not the conjugate of the original-weight Euler field unless e=d.
The actual Taylor projection pi gives A=C[pi(X1),...,pi(Xn)], with
possibly redundant dependent generators, not coordinates. For a
nonzero derivation T its exact shift is

    max( max_i deg_E T(pi(Xi)), deg_E T(u)-1 ).

Consequently a shift below the original positive delta is equivalent
to E^delta T(pi(Xi))=0 for every i and E^(delta+1)T(u)=0. These finite
coefficient conditions give an exact constructible EXISTENCE criterion
for a scalar replica improving the lexicographic pair. They do not
guarantee its nonemptiness or constitute an implemented solver.
An effective implementation needs an exact effective coefficient
field; arbitrary uneffectively specified complex inputs are not
silently made algorithmic. Full invariant coefficients still have
unbounded coefficient complexity, so the finite scalar parameter
space does not exhaust them.

The vertical E correction is essential. This N is primitive, since
gcd(a,b+1)=1, and has no slice since N(A) is contained in the proper
ideal(a,b+1). Put S=ker_A N without assuming a list of generators.

    Phi_F(Z)=Z+aF,
    Phi_F(W)=W+(b+1)F+a*u*F+(a/2)*F^2.

### 576: a general Euler dichotomy beyond the special chart

Let B=C[X1,...,Xn]=A[u], n>=2, with its actual slice and positive
coordinate E-degrees di. Positivity is attainable by a simultaneous
invertible linear shear of any zero-degree coordinates; no minimality
or special initial ideal is thereby promised. Define D=sum diXi partial_Xi.
Finite algebra generators of A and u prove that its exact all-ring
E-filtration shift delta is finite. Its eigenvector coordinates give
delta>=0.

If delta>0, local finiteness of D makes its nonzero top derivation
on gr_E(B)=A[eta] locally nilpotent: nonzero successive top iterates
would have strictly increasing degrees inside a finite-dimensional
D-orbit. LND divisibility forces the top derivation to kill eta.
Thus it equals eta^delta N for a nonzero LND N on A.
Every polynomial homogeneous in the ORIGINAL fixed source weights
is a D-eigenvector, so its leading coefficient is killed by N.
The algebra of ALL such initials lies in (ker N)[eta], and its
fraction field has transcendence degree at most n-1. Neither a
principal initial ideal nor a full-generator count or finite
generation of this initial algebra is required.

If delta=0, D preserves A. Finite spectral projections give A a
connected positive grading. The original Eu=1 makes A=B/(u)
smooth by the gradient criterion. Homogeneous lifts of a basis at
the vertex generate A by positive-weight induction; dimension then
makes A polynomial. Together with u these are actual coordinates.

The theorem is not an unconditional initial-rank bound: the zero-
shift branch can have full rank n and is instead recognized.
Nor does the positive branch supply a sliced N, an actual coordinate
move or a terminating process. A new presentation weight assigned
to a remainder is not its original Euler eigenvalue.

All three actual controls are fully invertible polynomial frames:
the565 (4,5,6,7) frame has delta12, N=-18 partial_c and a sharp
rank-three homogeneous-initial algebra. Its actual slice is recovered
by a mixed-original-weight polynomial. A second frame has delta10,
N=72a partial_c, a fixed divisor and no slice for this raw N; in
that example division by the invariant factor gives partial_c, so
primitive normalization is not refuted. The zero-shift
(u,a+u^2,b+u^3,c+u^4) frame has homogeneous positive remainders
au,bu,cu whose initials together with eta have rank four.

### 577: exact commutator recovery and a direct zero-shift test

For ANY nonzero polynomial derivation D in B=A[u], let
Cj=ad_E^j(D) and let r be the last nonzero order. Polynomial
conjugation exp(zE) D exp(-zE), evaluated on the finite actual
coordinate set, proves that r is finite without known generators
of A. Writing D=sum u^j Nj+b(u)E for the proof gives the exact
all-ring shift

    delta(D)=r if Cr wedge E is nonzero;
    delta(D)=r-1 if Cr wedge E is zero.

The wedge is tested by polynomial minors in the actual coordinates.
The vertical multiplier is polynomial because E has a slice.
The r=0,delta=-1 case and the zero-shift,nonvertical r=0 case
are retained for general D. For the special Euler weights di,
the positive-shift argument of576 forces r=delta and gives

    N=Cr|A/r!,
    N_tilde=(Cr-Cr(u)E)/r!.

Both Cr and N_tilde are actual LNDs commuting with E; they are
not claimed to commute with each other. Replacing u by u+a
changes N_tilde by -N(a)E but does not change its restriction
to A. The vertical correction is necessary even in a simple
invertible degree(2,1,1,1) frame.

For THESE Euler weights, delta=0 is equivalent to [E,D]=E.
At zero shift D preserves A and Du=b1u+b0. Comparing coordinate
leaders gives D(ci)=di(1-b1)ci. Positive source degree first
forces b1 to be complex. The graded VECTOR-SPACE quotient B/A,
not a quotient ring, then forces b1 to be a positive integer.
Nonnegative weights for the nonzero ci force b1=1 and ci in C*.
The converse follows from the terminal-commutator formula.
Thus initial rank at least two forces positive shift, whereas
rank one alone does not force zero shift.

An explicit invertible family

    (a+u^d+u^(d-1), b+u, c+u, u), d>=2,

has Euler field (da+u^(d-1))partial_a+b partial_b+c partial_c+
u partial_u, positive shift d-1, and arbitrarily large terminal
commutator order despite its known polynomial kernel and visible
coordinate slice. For d=2 the last commutator is partial_a+E;
the all-linear control has the same terminal order one but last
commutator E and shift zero. These actual controls do not assert
global minimality or provide a general descent.

have gcd one, yet N(A) lies in the proper ideal(a,b). This

coordinate degrees are exactly wi,1, with all leaders one.

### 561: saturation cannot repair all exceptional action fibers

In A=C[a,b,c], D1=partial_b and D2=a*partial_c+c*partial_b are primitive
commuting LNDs, independent over Frac(A), with common kernel C[a].
If g1(a)D1+g2(a)D2 is regular, its b-value g1+c*g2 is polynomial;
coefficient comparison forces both g_i into C[a]. Thus their C[a]
module is already saturated inside their C(a)-span. Nevertheless at
a=0, D2=c*D1, while EVERY quotient A/(a-alpha) is C[b,c]. The
fiber derivation rank is not the dimension of the abstract module
M/aM. Allowing c in a coefficient changes the specified saturation.

This entire family occurs as all four leading coordinate partials:

### 562: initial rank gives a stronger bound and a licensed shear

Let r_j be the transcendence degree of the OTHER THREE initial forms,
not the rank of their leading LNDs. Multiply the u-column of the actual
Jacobian by u. Its leading rows are (dc_i,d_i*c_i), of rank r_j.
Every three-row minor must use at least3-r_j lower rows. Dividing a
horizontal cofactor by the one rescaled u factor therefore gives

    k_j <= S-d_j-4+r_j.

At full initial rank one this improves560 to M<=(S-3)*ell. No
principal-ideal hypothesis or replacement of the actual cofactor
by a sampled leading determinant is used.

Initial rank one also forces a root-free monomial-curve presentation.
For g=gcd(d_i), Bezout gives T=c*eta^g in the fraction field of the
initial algebra. Its intersection with Frac(A) is exactly C, hence
c_i=lambda_i*c^(d_i/g), lambda_i complex nonzero. Normality returns
c to A. The full initial prime is exactly the corresponding
complex-scaled binomial monomial-curve ideal. If one degree belongs
to the semigroup generated by the other three, subtracting the
matching monomial with its COMPLEX coefficient is an actual
invertible coordinate shear and strictly lowers that degree.

The screen tests applicability, not novelty or completeness of the
literature. Geometry completed a separate screen. Root directly
inspected the following primary statements and their local context:

- [Liendo--Petitjean, Theorem1](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.14645v1)
  assumes a faithful complexity-two torus action, a unique fixed
  point and a specified two-dimensional quotient. The intrinsic
  slice-scaling action on A[u]=C^[4] has complexity three and fixed
  locus Spec(A) of dimension three. Those hypotheses are not supplied.
- [Isaev, Proposition4.2 and Remark4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.11678v1)
  concern flexibility of suspensions. The slice remark gives the
  intrinsic product decomposition, not polynomiality of the remaining
  factor. It does not construct an ambient coordinate for this problem.
- [Hajra--Upmanyu, TheoremA](https://arxiv.org/html/2606.26890v1)
  requires positive gradings with good multiplicative actions and
  vertices that are unique singularities. The present kernel is
  smooth, as536 proves, and no required positive grading is available.
- [Dasgupta--Gaifullin, Proposition4.1 and Theorem4.5](https://www.mathnet.ru/eng/sm10094)
  give commuting-derivation criteria for a polynomial THREE-ring.
  The ambient ring here has four variables. Applying the statements
  directly to the unknown kernel would assume its polynomiality.
  The paper's higher-dimensional rank-at-most-two statements also
  require invariant ambient coordinates that are not given here.
- [Dubouloz--Finston--Jaradat, affine-fourspace corollary](https://msp.org/ant/2014/8-8/ant-v8-n8-p06-p.pdf)
  proves that proper triangular additive actions are translations.
  A supplied global slice already makes our action proper: its
  action map identifies with the closed subspace of pairs having
  the same Spec(A) coordinate. Actual triangulability is the missing
  hypothesis, and is not inferred from B=A[u].

### 431: the transverse second derivative must vanish

Suppose f_ttt and ell_ss are nonzero. The exact (3,2)-weighted
leading form of Phi-q is a nonzero scalar times
(U^2+f_ttt P^3/6)^2. The cusp polynomial is irreducible over the
exact coefficient field by an odd valuation. Any selected
irreducible plane equation therefore has separate degrees
(2j,3j), j=1 or2. The whole polynomial-line return identifies
these with the two projection degrees. Neither divides the
other, contradicting the characteristic-zero
Abhyankar--Moh--Suzuki degree theorem. Thus ell_ss=0.

The primary source is Makar-Limanov, "A new proof of the
Abhyankar--Moh--Suzuki Theorem":
https://arxiv.org/pdf/1212.0163v1.
Its opening theorem allows an arbitrary characteristic-zero
coefficient field; Lemma1 gives the polynomial function-field
degree formula. Geometry checked it in turn4642view0, Root
in turn4643view0 and turn4645view0, General in turn4644view0.

and whole-ring generation are explicitly treated.

### 433: the longitudinal derivative of the slope must also vanish

Assume ell_ss=0 and e'=ell_ts nonzero. The complete primitive
is Phi=A(P)U^2+B(P)U+C(P), where A is exact degree one,
with leading coefficient -e'/e, and deg B at most two.
A constant sigma leaves Phi_P a nonunit quadratic in the
affine parameter y, contradicting the unit gradient.

If sigma is nonconstant, integrality makes its whole plane
equation monic in U, with U-degree deg_v sigma. Divisibility
by Phi-q leaves degree one or two. Degree two forces the
nonunit cofactor A(sigma), again contradicting the gradient.
Degree one makes sigma a parameter and y=g(sigma).
The gradient unit gives 2A g+B in L*, so g=alpha P+beta,
where alpha=e f_ttt/(4e')-f_tt/2.

The original slice licenses L[B]=L[v,X], so every evaluation
X=lambda must preserve whole-line generation. At X=-alpha,
Y is constant, Z has exact degree three, and W+alpha Z has
exact degree two, with nonzero leaders f_ttt/(6e) and
-e f_ttt/(4e'). Such a pair cannot generate L[sigma].
The note proves this directly: after normalization to
z^2 and z^3+c z, either distinct points collide (c nonzero)
or all generated functions have zero derivative at zero (c zero).
Thus e'=0. Together with431, the joint derivative constants
give e in C*. The remaining nonzero constant-e case is not solved.

quadratic module gives B_F=S+D*S*R with exact conductor D*T.

uses the actual strong return and derivation, not a guessed normality

### The new contact reduction409 and compatibility contradiction410

409 first removes complex lambda using actual384 with C0=2lambda.
The new theta slope stays nonzero because400 excludes mu in C+C*t.
Together with403--406, every surviving degree-one candidate has
delta,lambda_s,Kcal,beta and alpha=Dscript(lambda) nonzero.
Put A=delta/beta, xi=lambda, and use exact(t,xi) partials, dot
at fixed xi and prime at fixed t. The high equations give

    s'=2A^2+A*mu',
    dot s=mu+A*dot mu+4A*xi,
    A'*(dot mu+4xi)=(dot A-1)*(mu'+4A).

Set q=A-t. If dot q=0, the nonzero dot mu+4xi gate forces q'=0.
If q is complex, differentiating the ORIGINAL H-top equation and
keeping lambda_s forces exactly the normalized family excluded by408.
Thus q is noncomplex and dot q nonzero. The new basis(q,xi) is
separating. With F=ker(partial_xi|q), the explicit coefficient
B=A*(mu+4xi*A)-2xi*A^2-s satisfies dB=(mu+4xi*A)dq. Hence

    mu=B_q-4xi*(t+q),
    s=-2xi*(t+q)^2+(t+q)*B_q-B,    B in exact F.

The source proves F is finite over C(q), not equal to C(q).
No formula for arbitrary retained t(q,xi) is imposed.

410 shows this remaining contact family cannot contain the actual
potential n. With Wcal=Dscript(n) and Caux=B_qq-4xi, the original
H-top and beta=(xi-n_s)/A give

The term n_s*dmu is retained in deriving this identity. Define
EXISTING elements J=Wcal+2xi^2*t-xi*B_q+4xi^2*q and
M=n-xi*s-xi^2*t^2-J*t. No antiderivative is adjoined. Then
J_q=0 and the displayed derivatives of M in410 force closure

Its mixed derivative yields B_qqq*J_xixixi=-24, so both factors
are nonzero. Differentiating in q gives B_qqqq=0, while Ecal_qq
then gives 5B_qqq=0, a contradiction. Every t derivative is retained
until it cancels. The lower functions r,h,ell are never specialized.
This is the last necessary-condition contradiction in the exhaustive

### Further progress in this same pass: all-degree gates412 and reduction413

412 proves that the two high scalar gates first obtained for degree
one also hold for all equal degrees. This is not justified by an
analogy. In the full literal rows, exact wedge cancellations first
bound the total jet weights of J(X=0) and [X]J by four and three.
Every determinant term has exactly one intrinsic derivative, so
its intrinsic degree is at most weight*d-1. Replacing any value
or derivative by its lower-degree part strictly lowers that bound.
Only after these cancellations may the leading functions
y=lambda*a*v^d, sigma=a*v^d, theta=mu*a*v^d be substituted.
Their chain-rule factor is d*a*v^(d-1); the t,s derivatives of
the arbitrary nonzero a are retained and cancel by the triangular
chain rule, not assumed zero.

Before imposing Htop, the raw affine coefficients have residuals
mu_s*Htop and -2lambda_s*Htop. The actual H level supplies Htop=0.
The full scalar's coefficients of X*v^(3d-1) and v^(4d-1) therefore
give exactly

    2delta*alpha+beta*Kchar=0,
    (beta-delta*mu_s)*alpha+delta*Kchar*lambda_s=0.

This proof keeps zero slopes and zero rank factors. It imports no
degree-one conductor, coordinate normalization or lower scalar proof.

413 combines these gates with407's NONEXCEPTIONAL curvature condition.
If delta=0, the second gate forces beta=0 and the exact(t,n_s)
Legendre calculation gives Kchar=0. If lambda is complex, either
beta!=0 immediately gives Kchar=0, or beta=0 gives the same result
by a separate exact Legendre integration; lambda=0 is included.
It remains to suppose delta,Kchar nonzero and lambda noncomplex.

If lambda_s=0,413 reproduces only the coefficient compatibility
part of406. With v1=mu_s and f=delta/v1-mu/2 in ker(partial_s),
an exact Laurent integration gives s=p0*U+p1/U+p2, U=mu+2f.
The U^-4 coefficient forces p1=0, hence (v1)_s=0 and
e=-v1^2/2. Thus beta^2+2e*delta^2=0, contradicting407.
No degree-one scalar or actual normalization is used.

For lambda_s!=0, the coefficient calculation of409 applies to the
new high gates. Its nonconstant-q contact family is impossible by

The constant-q boundary is NOT excluded by applying408: instead
beta=delta/T and the differentiated H-top force e=-1/(2T^2),
again contradicting407's nonzero curvature. Thus every remaining
higher-degree case has Kchar=0. The first gate, with its delta-zero

### Degree-one necessary family and actual-return exclusion401--403

401 retains zero slopes in its high H/Q coefficients and literal
scalar equations. In the subcase delta=lambda-n_s=0, its two high
scalar coefficients force beta=n_ts+n_ss*mu=0. The legitimate
coefficient basis (t,xi=n_s) gives an exact Legendre integration
with A,B,Lambda in F=ker(dot), not assumed rational in xi. The
complete scalar forces B''=(A'')^2/8 and Hbar=-g(t+A''/4), with
g=2r+n_t and dot g nonzero. The remaining scalar is

    g*dot(g)/8 * [A'''(g+xi^2*A'')+2A'A''+xi*(A'')^2-4Lambda''].

It is potentially nonzero. No exclusion follows from401 alone.

Root402 uses the actual strong return, not an additional scalar
ansatz. With p=P-xi*t-A'/2, all three intercepts lie in F[g,p],
forcing L=F(g) by field intersection. With R=p+tX, every full
literal row lies in T=F[X,g,R]. Eliminating g using Y gives a
monic quadratic for R over B_F=F[B], so T=B_F[R] is finite,
birational, and the integral closure of B_F. Actual E stability
gives d0=a0 and d1=a0*t in F[g]. The original global slice further
forces gcd(d0,d1)=1, yielding T=F[g,V,u] and finite normalization
F[g,V] of F[A0]. It does NOT prove F[A0] is normal or equal to
that polynomial ring. That distinction is essential.

Root403 resolves this subcase by using the discrepancy instead.
Put S=F[X,Y,Z]. The monic quadratic makes T=S+S*R free of rank
two, proved by even/odd degree. The complete W remainder is C+D*R,
where C is in S and

    D=-A+A'(X+xi)-A''(X+xi)^2/2-2Y.

Thus B_F=S+D*S*R and its EXACT conductor in T is D*T. Since
both rings are stable under the actual E, the Leibniz rule forces
the conductor to be E-stable. But in T,

    D=-g-2(X+xi)R-A''(X+xi)^2/2,
    E(D)=-2d0*R-(X+xi)(A''d0+2d1).

Divisibility D|E(D) would require (X+xi)*Q=d0(g) with Q inF[g,X].
Evaluation at X=-xi contradicts d0 nonzero. This is an identity
of polynomial rings, not evaluation at an unlicensed original
chart point. It excludes the entire delta-zero degree-one family,
including A''=0, without assuming normality of either smaller ring.

### Classical one-variable parameter clarification

Geometry independently checked a classical fact useful for future
work: F=C(a) for some a in F already follows from F contained in
K=C(y,z,w), with F finite over C(t). It does not require376.
A smooth projective curve with function field F exists by
[Stacks0BY1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BY1), and the field
inclusion gives a dominant rational map from affine three-space by
[Stacks0BXN](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BXN). Choose two
points in its domain with different images and restrict to their
affine line. The resulting nonconstant rational map extends to a
map from the projective line by
[Stacks0BXZ](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BXZ).
[Riemann--Hurwitz](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0C1D) forces
the target genus to be zero. A complex point and the
[projective-line criterion](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0C6U)
then give the rational parameter a. Root freshly read all five
primary pages in4579/4580 after Geometry's independent reconstruction.

This is implicit classical rationality, not new branch coverage.

[366](research/principal-paraboloid-nonlinear-first-constant-sigma-exclusion-pass366-working.md)

tau-map and exact parameters xi=2t*sigma+s give

z=(xi-2b2)^2/(4t^2)+z0, with b1,b2,z0 complex. Thus the actual
coordinate polynomial Z-2b2X-z0 is a square in Frac(B). Its prime
valuation one in the actual polynomial UFD makes this impossible.
The nonzero xi_s and all parameter factors are explicitly proved.

  excludes ell_ss nonzero. The unit plane cofactor gives four exact

rho,b nonzero and Lx=X+h, it uses

    F=Lx*t+(b/rho)*V^2+C/rho,
    Yhat=V+Lx*F,
    N0=t-(b/rho)*(2*V*F+Lx*F^2).

    F=Lx*N0+(b/rho)*Yhat^2+C/rho,
    V=Yhat-Lx*F,
    t=N0+(b/rho)*(2*Yhat*F-Lx*F^2).

The actual rows S=W-XZ and Ztilde=Z-(cX-b)S satisfy
Ztilde=rho*N0+c*Y^2+d0*(X-h)-e0. They recover N0 using only complex
denominators; the displayed S identity recovers r polynomially.

inverse over a localization with a nonconstant denominator.

### The new endpoint

[323](research/principal-paraboloid-all-conic-polynomial-specialization-exclusion-pass323-working.md)
proves a general polynomial-generation obstruction. In K[X,v], suppose two
generators are quadratic in v, their linear coefficients vary affinely with
X, the third is cubic with nonzero X-independent leading coefficient, and
the cross-difference of the first two moving slopes is nonzero. A value of
X in K makes one quadratic redundant. The other quadratic and the cubic
cannot generate K[v], by the exact even/odd module decomposition. The first
quadratic is allowed to have zero quadratic coefficient.

For the actual reciprocal conic, the full coefficient-adjoined equality
L[B]=L[X,sigma] follows directly from the actual derivative
sigma=EY/a-2tX. This is an equality of specified subrings of the original
fraction field, not an ambient coordinate assertion. With T=t-tau and
m=d+c/T, c nonzero, the three required coefficients are

```text
z2 = 1 - 2*t*d*c/(c+d*T)^2 + 2*c/(c+d*T)
w3 = 2*c/(c+d*T)^2
r  = (3*c+d*T)/(c+d*T)
```

All are nonzero in L, including d=0. Evaluation at X in L fixes the
coefficient field; no moving coefficient is differentiated. This excludes
the entire genuine-conic sector of302/306/315. It does not need316/318,
the stronger generic-plane return,319's rank-two action, or320's
triangularization argument. Irreducible surfaces and arbitrary chart entry
are not covered.

### Exact controls for the genuinely remaining normalized quartic cases

The reviewed
[330](research/principal-paraboloid-normalized-potential-family-recognition-pass330-working.md)

potential in coefficient parameters t,r=ell is

```text
Q(U,P)=Hrr*U^4/2+Htr*U^2*P+Htt*P^2/2
       +2*U*P+Ht*U-Lr*U^2-Lt*P.
```

Here every jet is in the unchanged exact coefficient field. The formal
substitutions below do not differentiate moving line parameters.

For (deg y,deg sigma)=(1,2), write sigma=A2*y^2+A1*y+A0. If A1 is
nonzero, all-X generation specializes at X=-1/A1. The actual identity
Y^2+XW-X^2Z=y^2+ell*X makes the specialized generator ring exactly
L[y^2,W0], where W0 has exact degree three. The parity obstruction gives
a contradiction. Thus A1=0; substituting into the full Q leaves the
nonzero cubic coefficient 2*A2, again impossible.

For (1,4), constancy of the same Q successively gives Htt=0 from its
eighth coefficient, then Htr=0 from its sixth. Its fifth coefficient
is then 2*A4, which is nonzero. All lower terms were retained.

For (2,4), center the line parameter over L so y=a*x^2+h. The whole
polynomial-plane return, not mere birationality, forces
sigma=A*y^2+B*y+D+C*x with A,C nonzero: its odd module must contain x,
so the odd coefficient is a unit. The odd part of Q forces
Htr+Htt*A=0, Htt*B+2=0, Htt*D-Lt=0. The remaining even part is
Hrr*y^4/2-Htt*(A*y^2+B*y+D)^2/2+Ht*y-Lr*y^2
+Htt*C^2*(y-h)/(2*a), whose cubic coefficient is 2*A, nonzero.

### New mathematical conclusion

Under the full actual chart264, a reducible surface with projected line,
sigma_v nonzero and m_s=0 cannot occur. This is the precise scope of
[312](research/principal-paraboloid-legendre-conductor-exclusion-pass312-working.md),
using the complete retained reduction
[310](research/principal-paraboloid-line-legendre-field-reduction-pass310-working.md).

The new argument is not an attempt to erase310's genuine rational
denominator. Its steps are:

1. The full scalar and exact Legendre constants give L=F(eta) and the
   actual fraction field F(X,S,eta), with independent polynomial variables.
   The displayed normalization is N=F[X,S,eta]=F[X,Y,S].
2. Actual EX and EY, together with a in L, force a and a*t into F[eta].
   Thus the original E explicitly restricts to the LND
   a(eta)*partial_X+(a*t)(eta)*partial_S on N. No general extension
   theorem or unproved normality of R=F[X,Y,Z,W] is used.
3. With C=F[X,Y,Z], the exact decompositions are N=C+CS and R=C+DCS,
   as direct sums. Multiplication by S proves conductor(R,N)=D*N,
   including at points where D vanishes.
4. Stability of both rings makes the conductor E-stable. Hence D divides
   ED in N, and local nilpotence forces ED=0. Its actual formula has
   S-coefficient -2a, which is nonzero. This is the contradiction.

### Mathematical changes and precise scope

- [Frontier258](research/two-affine-quadratic-cubic-frontier-pass258-working.md)
  develops the actual1123 height-two chart with quadratic-slot shift three.
  It reconstructs the calibration \(-a^3\), both first potentials, a nonzero
  quartic whole-plane relation in the nonzero-coupling case, and an affine
  graph reduction in the nonzero scalar zero-coupling case. Zero shifts
  and the zero-scalar endpoint are recognized. This is not all1123.
- [Frontier259](research/one-affine-three-quadratic-frontier-pass259-working.md)
  recognizes actual1222 frames with a zero selected bad shift or all three
  shifts one. The latter implies \(B_1^3=0,\ D_pq=B_1^2\), exactly in that
  shift case. The exact common field and actual localization produce
  \(\mathcal R=F[r,s]\). Both Jacobian matrices have entries in that ring,
  so the determinant is a unit. Its factorization forces the normalized
  leader curve to be a complex affine line, giving an actual shear.
  Higher-shift proportional-top cases remain open and occur in ordinary
  polynomial examples. Principal initial relation weights are two or four;
  the weight-four cases are not all recognized.
- [Audit260](research/three-good-chain-independent-audit-pass260-working.md)
  independently reconstructs the arbitrary-length \(n\ge3\) differential
  obstruction used by156, retaining all coefficient derivatives and
  evaluating the critical fiber only after differentiation. The explicit
  length-two formal chart has a unit Jacobian and whole generic-line
  return, but its actual target field has index two. The proposed
  derivation fails even field descent. This is not a sliced-ring
  counterexample or a polynomial Keller counterexample.
- [Criterion261](research/horizontal-triple-minor-rank-criterion-pass261-working.md)
  proves the exact complementary-minor identity for arbitrary positive
  coordinate time degrees. The equality
  \(\sum_{i\ne\ell}k_i=d_\ell-1\) is equivalent to independence of the
  corresponding three leading actions and recognizes the kernel.
  The minors generate the unit ideal over \(K[u]\), but polynomial
  module reduction need not preserve coordinate-partial integrability
  or local nilpotence. Explicit actual examples show all four
  inequalities can be strict for a polynomial kernel.
- [Endpoint262](research/two-affine-quadratic-cubic-graph-pencil-pass262-working.md)
  closes258's maximal-pivot affine graph when \(m=0,\nu\ne0,q'''\ne0\),
  without assuming that \(\nu\) is constant. Replace the coefficient
  parameter \(\lambda\) by \(n\), retaining the finite field extension.
  With \(H=\lambda\), the scalar eighth-degree coefficient forces
  \(H_{nnn}=0\). The fifth- and second-degree coefficients then make
  \(H_n\ell\) and the remaining intercept polynomial in \(n\).
  This proves \(w\in F[y,z]\) before exact field return yields
  \(K=F(y,z)\). The generic pencil has a single simple pole, and the
  scalar differential identity makes its varying direction constant.
  The full calibrated determinant makes the final ambient correction
  coefficientwise complex. The resulting invariant polynomial coordinate
  has an explicit polynomial inverse, so the regular-kernel theorem applies.
  The old affine and square-root coefficient modes are both covered.

The entire zero-coupling branch of the specified maximal-pivot chart
now composes as follows: \(\nu=0\) is258's actual three-ring endpoint;
\(\nu\ne0,q'''=0\) has the actual homogenized-quadratic shear in262,
followed by the retained three-good156 or invariant-coordinate endpoint;
\(\nu\ne0,q'''\ne0\) is262. This composition uses the retained156
recognition for a lowered profile, not a new proof of that input.
It does not recognize the nonzero-coupling quartic or an arbitrary1123 frame.

### Targeted literature screen, not a novelty audit

A recent survey is not being used as a theorem input:
[Venegas and Venegas, v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.15590v1),
Theorem2.4, asserts ML(A[t])=ML(A) for every affine characteristic-zero
domain. This fails for the Koras--Russell cubic: the original
[Dubouloz paper](https://arxiv.org/html/0807.4085v1) states ML(X)=C[x]
but proves ML(X times A1)=C. Its introduction explicitly distinguishes
that result from showing the cylinder is affine four-space. Thus
Example2.6 of the survey is also not evidence for the asserted
complex-threefold cancellation counterexample. Root checked these
specific statements, not an independent proof of Dubouloz's theorem
or every assertion in either paper. No inference about the authors
is made.

The new [Hajra--Upmanyu preprint](https://arxiv.org/html/2606.26890v1)
was screened at its introduction and Theorem13. Its cited recognition
result assumes positively graded complex domains with a good action
and a unique singular vertex. Those hypotheses do not directly cover
our smooth cancellation factor. A singular associated graded ring
cannot be substituted for the original ring. This limited screen
does not establish novelty or rule out every use of that paper.

## September 15, 2026: quadratic split projection is excluded, leaving an affine parameter

The [proof-only exclusion177](research/split-quadratic-projection-exclusion-pass177-working.md)
starts from the whole plane ring and unit evaluated cofactor proved
in175--176. If \(y\) were quadratic, completing the square over the
exact field \(L\) gives \(y=b+a_2x^2\). The inverse derivative forces
a nonzero linear odd coefficient of \(\vartheta\); point separation
eliminates its cubic odd coefficient. Thus
\(y=b+a\zeta^2,\ \vartheta=P(y)+\zeta\), with \(\deg P\le2\).
No coefficient-field extension defines \(\zeta\), and no coefficient
derivative is silently changed after this parameter description.

The selected relation is \(G=U-b-a(V-P(U))^2\), of total degree
two or four and V-degree two. If its total degree is four,
the quartic eliminant is \(cG\). If it is two, the evaluated unit
cofactor and total degree give \(cG+\lambda G^2\); the eliminant's
V-degree at most three forces \(\lambda=0\). In either case its
literal V-cubic coefficient must vanish. That coefficient is
\((r-U)k_{\rho\rho\rho}/6-r_\rho^2/2\), so \(r_\rho=0\),
contradicting the nonzero quadratic-center coefficient required
by176's root-count bound.

The quadratic contradiction is independent of176's constant-y
exclusion. Combining both exclusions with the degree bound gives
\(y=\alpha v+\beta\), \(\alpha\in L^*\), and
\(\vartheta=P_*(y)\) of degree at most four. This is an exact-field
generic graph, not a global invariant coordinate or recognition
of the split kernel. No178 conclusion is used.

The main theorem works for a domain over a characteristic-zero field,
with nonzero LND D, invariant ring C, and local slice Dr=g nonzero in C.
For A,B in C and B=1+gQ, E=AD+B*partial_t has a slice exactly when
(A,B)C=C. A Bezout completion BM+gAL=1 supplies an explicit polynomial
automorphism: evaluate the finite D-flow at W=Qr-At and send t to
Lr+Mt. The inverse uses W'=((M-1)/g)r+At and t maps to -Lr+Bt.
The matrices are inverse after localizing at g, so injectivity of
localization proves inverse maps on the original ring. E kills the
new base coordinates and sends the new t-coordinate to one.

The necessary direction is valid in nonreduced quotients: modulo B,
g is invertible and the local-slice presentation is a polynomial ring
over C/(B). Evaluate the resulting polynomial inverse of A at zero.
There is no unsupported assertion that polynomial units over rings
with nilpotents are constant. Flow evaluation is not exp(WD), since
DW can be nonzero. No elementary matrix factorization is assumed.

The concrete class A=g^2, B=1+g*eta has slice
(1-g*eta+g^2*eta^2)t-eta^3*r and explicit invariant coordinates.
For independent g,eta its coefficient row is not elementarily
reducible over C[g,eta], by Cohn's original 1966 example. The matrix
lift still works. Thus the elementary-row obstruction does not
obstruct general polynomial conjugacy. The bounded primary-source

top symbol is s^q*delta with delta a nonzero LND on K. This corrects the
research map but does not provide a coordinate, slice, or proper action on K.

Applied to ambient coordinate partials, this gives commuting intrinsic LNDs.
Generic rank three would prove K is affine three-space, using closed unipotent
orbits. But exact polynomial-coordinate examples show that all four leading
symbols can have rank one, and even share a nonunit plinth ideal. Lower
coefficients, intermediate commutators, and projection to s=0 do not generally
preserve local nilpotence. The corresponding nonzero iterate formulas are
proved explicitly, not inferred from a finite timeout. Positive controls
show that these examples do not rule out every possible repair.

The stable-coordinate route supplies a genuine one-variable stabilization
but no general descent theorem in four variables. A useful independent
obstruction excludes every P=x+x^m*y+z^r+w^q with m,r,q>=2 from being a
slice or stable coordinate. All its fibers are smooth, but their compactly
supported Euler characteristics are 1 at zero and 1-(r-1)*(q-1) elsewhere.
For the Russell polynomial the nonzero value is -1. A conflicting printed
value encountered in the literature was checked against the direct
stratification rather than repeated. This result concerns the polynomial's
whole fiber family, not cancellation of the abstract zero-fiber cylinder.

The dilation-torus route was checked against current complexity-two results.
Our action has complexity three, and linearizing it is equivalent to the
cancellation instance. The dimension mismatch prevents importing the
positive-dimensional-fixed-locus theorem as a general solution.

All eight preexisting suites were rerun: 107 test methods passed. The new
global-filtration suite adds 19 passing methods, for 126 total. The topology
argument remains a written proof, not proof-assistant verification. Reports:
deep-pass-05.md, research/intrinsic-actions-pass.md,
research/filtration-obstruction-pass.md, research/stable-coordinate-pass.md,
and research/full-chain-audit.md. Claims Z034-Z043 record the exact scope.
The stable-coordinate appendix also proves the quadratic positive case and
the necessary singular-leading-surface condition for cubic slices. Its
factor-count argument shows that Kuroda's stable Newton/divisibility
obstruction is automatic through degree three in four variables.

Next bounded investigation: seek additional structure beyond mere intrinsic
nonrigidity that follows from K[s] being polynomial. Any proposed use of
coefficient extraction, commutators, projection, properness descent, or torus
linearization must first survive the explicit controls now recorded. Do not

No external contact, submission, publication, paid access, or automation
